results.title: Ghana Government: New Printing Directive Mandates 20% for GPCL | Briefly
results.snippet: The Ghanaian government has formally issued a Cabinet directive mandating that up to 20 percent of all its printing assignments be allocated to the Ghana Publishing Company Limited (GPCL). This significant policy shift was confirmed by Nana Kwasi Boatey, the Managing Director of GPCL, during his address at the Government Accountability Series held at Jubilee House on Monday, November 2.
